whisper_internal: Internal only. Never heard by the caller — not part of the spoken call.
whisper_none: No whispers were sent on this call.
whisper_outcome_1: Not voiced — Mohamed took over and said it himself at 00:49.
whisper_outcome_2: Voiced by the agent at 01:06 in its own voice.
summary_body: Ms Gruber moved her Tuesday 14:00 appointment to Thursday 10:00 and asked whether her quote was still valid. Reception confirmed it is valid until 30 September. SMS confirmation sent.
tool_failed_body_before: SMS confirmation to the caller — gateway timed out.
tool_failed_body_strong: Ms Gruber was told she would receive an SMS and did not receive one.
empty_title: Speech recognition returned nothing for this call
empty_body: The call connected and lasted 2:38, but the recorder wrote a silent track — the audio stream from the provider carried no signal, so there was nothing to transcribe. This usually means the RTP media path was blocked while signalling stayed up.
offline_title: Phone line offline — SIP registration lost
offline_body_before: No incoming calls are being answered. Provider
offline_body_after: — 4 calls missed. Historical calls remain readable.
error_label: Call record could not be loaded
error_title: The recording store did not respond
error_body: Tel-Agent reached the database and found this call, but the storage volume holding the audio and transcript did not answer within 10 seconds. The record is not lost — it could not be read right now.
error_try_body: Check that the storage volume is mounted, then reload. If it keeps failing, the diagnostics page shows the last write the recorder made.
